name: phone-drop
description: Drop files from your computer onto your phone over local Wi-Fi: scan a QR code and download. Optional 'open in app' handlers, with Feather (.ipa sideloading) built in.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: auto = HTTPS once the one-time certificate setup is done, otherwise plain HTTP (no setup needed). https = always require the certificate. http = never use it.

apps.title: Open-in apps
apps.description: Apps a file can be opened in, as name=URL template. {url} is the file's HTTPS link, {url_encoded} the percent-encoded form. Example: myapp=myapp://import?url={url_encoded}

auto_open.title: Auto-open by file type
auto_open.description: Open matching files in an app instead of downloading them, as extension=app. Example: ipa=feather. Remove all entries to always download.

timeout_minutes.title: Timeout (minutes)
timeout_minutes.description: Stop serving if no download completes within this time.
